title: Large ledger with render budget constraints

turns.prompt: Current objective: ship the v2 API gateway by Friday. Acknowledge.

script.content: Acknowledged. Objective: ship the v2 API gateway by Friday.

turns.prompt: Filler: list three gateway rate-limit strategies.

script.content: Strategies: token bucket, sliding window, fixed window with jitter.

turns.prompt: Filler: compare the strategies for cold-start latency.

script.content: Token bucket: instant headroom. Sliding window: accurate but heavier. Fixed window: cheapest, bursty at edges.

turns.prompt: Despite the huge legacy ledger: what ship date and product are in the current objective?

script.content: Ship the v2 API gateway by Friday.

extractionRecords.text: Ship the v2 API gateway by Friday.

notes: 120 pre-seeded ledger records stress the render budget; the fresh objective must survive packing alongside legacy records.
